text:
aisha_csm: FYI — Sylvan Tech wants to onboard a customer-trained 7B model for internal doc retrieval. They flagged PHI in training data, want private (VPC) deployment + HSM for key management, and an enablement workshop next week. Also asking for latency target p50 < 150ms for small queries. Attaching their intake form and eval spreadsheet.

ravi_se: got it. do we have the dataset size + avg doc length? that affects KV cache strategy.

aisha_csm: they said ~120k docs, avg 400 tokens. most queries are short (10-30 tokens).

tom_mleng: short queries + 7B => we can hit p50 100-140ms on rtx6000-class dedicated if we optimize batching and kv cache. need quantization plan (int8/ltq) & to confirm model architecture (llama2-7b variant?).

ravi_se: can they retrain w/ PII redaction or do they need us to host raw PHI? Affects contract + compliance.

aisha_csm: legal asked — they require us to treat data as PHI, cannot send to external processors. customer prefers we host in their VPC (Redwood Private).

grace_support: renewal risk note — this looks like a custom private engagement. upsell opportunity but also cost+SLA discussion. need to surface T&C and estimated professional services hours to account execs.

deploy-bot: Ticket #CS-8729 created for "Sylvan Tech private model intake". Assignees: ravi_se, tom_mleng. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-8729 :white_check_mark:

ravi_se: action items from my side: 1) confirm model file format + quantization options, 2) draft security checklist for HSM + KMS integration, 3) propose canary rollout plan for private environment.

Tom_mleng: I'll run a perf sweep locally on a similar 7B (Llama2-7b-like) with int8 and int4 kernels and share latency/cost estimates. ETA 48h.

Aisha_csm: Customer requested an enablement session for their ML ops team on: deployment flow, keys & secrets, and safeties. Can we schedule 60m next Wed 11am PT?

grace_support: I'll block that and prep a renewal/PS RACI to send to sales. Also recommend adding a "quality guardrail" eval to the onboarding: 200 prompt pairs (realistic queries) with expected correctness thresholds.

ravi_se: please upload their eval spreadsheet to the shared folder and give me access. Also need PM/Legal to sign off on PHI hosting in their VPC.

Aisha_csm: uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/sylvan-intake/sylvan-eval-2026.xlsx — shared with the team.

Tom_mleng: quick config snippet suggestion for Private deployment (for discussion):
```json
{
  "deployment_mode": "private",
  "instance_profile": "dedicated-gpu-1",
  "model": "custom-sylvan-7b",
  "quantization": "int8",
  "hsm_integration": true,
  "kv_cache": "enabled",
  "latency_slo_p50_ms": 150
}
```

ravi_se: looks good. note: if they insist on int4 for cost, we need fallback plan for hallucination/regression tests. include eval suite named `sylvan-core-regressions`.

Aisha_csm: Sylvan also asked about timeline — they prefer go-live within 3 weeks. Is that realistic?

Tom_mleng: 3 weeks is tight but doable if: model files available day 0, VPC peering + HSM certs within 5 business days, and our perf/evals done in parallel. need PS hours estimate.

grace_support: I'll draft PS estimate and cc Sales. Also marking this thread as high touch — potential renewal influence.

ravi_se: tagging for follow-up: @tom_mleng will share perf numbers by EOD tomorrow, I'll share security checklist + canary plan by Friday. Aisha, please confirm enablement invite and confirm the go/no-go criteria from Sylvan (list of 5 items).

Aisha_csm: will confirm go/no-go list with customer and post update here. thanks all :thumbsup:
